answer: A mechanism that actually bites: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because wander only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, sonnet is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any copper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
